Answers below.

**h01** — `s3presign.Runner` — every 12 hours (plus one immediate run at startup) — wired at `server/server.go:162-171` (inside `startBackgroundRunners`, called from `Start` at `server/server.go:129`).
- Component: `s3presign.Runner` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:16`), work done in `CheckAndPresign` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:47`) which re-presigns S3 object URLs whose 5-day expiry is within 4 days and writes the new `Reference` back via `UpdateAttachment` (`:116`).
- Schedule: `runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27`), ticker loop in `Run` (`:29`).
- Wiring: `s3presign.NewRunner(s.Store)` `server/server.go:162`; immediate `RunOnce(ctx)` `server/server.go:163`; background `Run(s3Context)` goroutine `server/server.go:169`.

**h02** — delivery function: `webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120` (actual send at `:152`, `safeClient.Do(req)`); protection: SSRF guard via `safeDialContext` + `isReservedIP` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:59` and `internal/webhook/validate.go:44`.
- `safeClient` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:32`) uses a custom `Transport.DialContext` that resolves the host and rejects reserved/private IPs at dial time (defeats DNS rebinding).
- Reserved CIDRs list: `internal/webhook/validate.go:14-23` (loopback, RFC-1918, link-local/IMDS 169.254.0.0/16, IPv6 equivalents).
- Second layer at configuration time: `webhook.ValidateURL` (`internal/webhook/validate.go:62`) — scheme must be http/https and hostname must not resolve to a reserved IP.
- Escape hatch: `webhook.AllowPrivateIPs` (`internal/webhook/validate.go:41`), set from the `--allow-private-webhooks` flag at `cmd/memos/main.go:47`.

**h03** — abstraction package: `github.com/usememos/memos/internal/idp` (`internal/idp/idp.go`, defines `IdentityProviderUserInfo`); implementation package: `github.com/usememos/memos/internal/idp/oauth2` (`internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go:20`, `IdentityProvider` + `NewIdentityProvider` at `:27`). OAuth2/OIDC is the only concrete protocol shipped.

**h04** — no.
- Evidence: the only non-test reference to `mysql.NewDB` in the repo is `store/db/db.go:22`, inside the `switch profile.Driver` factory `NewDBDriver` (`store/db/db.go:14`). A repo-wide grep for `mysql.NewDB(` returns exactly that one hit; the only direct driver constructions elsewhere are `sqlite.NewDB` in tests (`store/demo_seed_test.go:24`, `store/deployment_config_test.go:416`). MySQL driver test setup goes through `store/test/store.go:106` (`os.Getenv("DRIVER")`) → the same factory.

**h05** — explicit Go code, per-driver, inside the delete-user transaction; there is no database-level cascade.
- Explicit deletes: `deleteReactionsByContentIDsTx` (reactions *on* the user's memos) and `deleteReactionsByCreatorTx` (reactions *by* the user), sequenced in `deleteUserTargetsTx` — `store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:93` and `:99`, with the SQL at `store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:383` and `:401`; identical code in `store/db/postgres/user_delete.go:383,401` and `store/db/mysql/user_delete.go:420,438`.
- Entry point: `store.Store.DeleteUser` (`store/user.go:171`) → `driver.DeleteUser` (`store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:29`).
- Checked for a DB rule: the `reaction` table has no foreign key / `ON DELETE CASCADE` (`store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:92-98`, `store/migration/postgres/LATEST.sql:91-97`, `store/migration/mysql/LATEST.sql:91-97`); the only FK in the schema is `memo_share.memo_id` (`store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:109`).

**h06** — handlers (all on `*APIV1Service`):
- `CreateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70` → `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` at `:157`
- `UpdateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:401` → `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` at `:513`
- `DeleteMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:518` → `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` at `:562`
- `CreateMemoComment` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:20` → `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` at `:119`
- also `SetMemoRelations` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go:48`) and `SetMemoAttachments` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:48`) via the same side-effects helper.

Convergence function: `webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`. All paths funnel through `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`/`DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` → `webhook.PostAsync` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:184`) → `asyncPostQueue` → the 4 worker goroutines in `init()` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:42-55`) → `Post`.

**h07** — hops for `GET /file/users/{identifier}/avatar`:
- route registration: `fileGroup.GET("/users/:identifier/avatar", s.serveUserAvatar)` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:124`
- `FileServerService.serveUserAvatar` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168`
- `FileServerService.getUserByUsername` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715`
- `store.Store.GetUser` — `store/user.go:148` (checks `userCache` only when finding by ID)
- `store.Store.ListUsers` — `store/user.go:136`
- `store.Driver.ListUsers` (interface) — `store/driver.go` → concrete `(*DB).ListUsers` in `store/db/sqlite/user.go` (default driver)
- back in the handler: `parseDataURI(user.AvatarURL)` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:196`; bytes are decoded from the base64 data-URI stored in the `user.avatar_url` column, then `c.Blob(...)` at `:208`.

**h08** — two declarers of `RunOnce`:
- `*s3presign.Runner.RunOnce` — `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43` — **invoked from production** — callers: `server/server.go:163` (`startBackgroundRunners`) and `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:36` (ticker loop in `Run`).
- `*memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27` — **not invoked anywhere** (no production or test callers; the package is used only via the package-level `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` at `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` and `:447`). `memopayload.NewRunner` is likewise never called.

**h09** — count: 8 method declarations of `Close` in backend Go code (6 non-test, 2 test-only), plus 2 interface declarations.
- Non-test declarers: `*sqlite.DB` (`store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:67`), `*mysql.DB` (`store/db/mysql/mysql.go:47`), `*postgres.DB` (`store/db/postgres/postgres.go:46`), `*store.Store` (`store/store.go:72`), `*cache.Cache` (`store/cache/cache.go:187`), `*v1.SSEHub` (`server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:99`).
- Test-only: `*MemoFilterTestContext` and `*AttachmentFilterTestContext` (`store/test/filter_helpers_test.go:200,282`).
- Interface declarations: `store.Driver.Close` (`store/driver.go:12`), `cache.Interface.Close` (`store/cache/cache.go:31`).

Invoked by non-test server code:
- `*store.Store.Close` ← `server/server.go:146` (`Server.Shutdown`)
- `*v1.SSEHub.Close` ← `server/server.go:206` (`closeLongLivedConnections`)
- `*cache.Cache.Close` ← `store/store.go:74,75,76` (three caches)
- `*sqlite.DB.Close` / `*mysql.DB.Close` / `*postgres.DB.Close` ← `store/store.go:78` (`s.driver.Close()`, dynamic dispatch; only the configured driver's runs — sqlite by default)

**h10** — `(*Engine).CompileToStatement` — `internal/filter/engine.go:74` — ~36 callers.
Caveat on the raw index: `Len` (`internal/version/version.go:44`, 180) and `Next` (`internal/scheduler/parser.go:92`, 54) rank higher but are name-collision artifacts — their "callers" are generic `.Len()` / `sql.Rows.Next()` call sites (e.g. `store/db/mysql/memo.go`), not calls to those symbols. Runners-up among genuine symbols: `filter.NewEngine` (`internal/filter/engine.go:24`, ~32) and `filter.NewSchema` (`internal/filter/schema.go:89`, ~29). If tests are excluded, the leader is `(*renderCtx).addArg` (`internal/filter/render.go:842`, ~14 production callers).

**h11** — 1st: `store.User` (`store/user.go:36`) — ~6 packages outside `store/` (`server/auth`, `server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/fileserver`, `server/router/rss`; ~65 references). 2nd: `store.Memo` (`store/memo.go:35`) — ~4 packages (`server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/rss`, `server/runner/memopayload`; ~42 references). Next is `store.Attachment` at ~3 packages.

**h12** — concrete method: `(*sqlite.DB).CreateMemo` — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16`, with the `INSERT INTO \`memo\` ... RETURNING` statement built at `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:41`.
Determination: the interface call `s.driver.CreateMemo` (`store/memo.go:113`) dispatches over `store.Driver` (`store/driver.go`), which has three implementations (sqlite/mysql/postgres). The concrete one is fixed at startup by `db.NewDBDriver`'s `switch profile.Driver` (`store/db/db.go:16-25`); with no flags, `driver` defaults to `"sqlite"` (`cmd/memos/main.go:122` `viper.SetDefault("driver","sqlite")` and `:130` flag default), passed into `profile.Driver` at `cmd/memos/main.go:43` and used at `cmd/memos/main.go:57`. So the sqlite branch (`store/db/db.go:20`) is the one that runs.

**h13** — impl: the unexported `service` struct in `internal/markdown/markdown.go` (`type service struct` ~`:59`; `ExtractAll` at `:356`, `parse` at `:116`) — it is the **only** implementation of `markdown.Service` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:31`).
- Construction: `markdown.NewService(...)` — `internal/markdown/markdown.go:85`; production call site `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48` (with `WithTagExtension`/`WithMentionExtension` options); test construction at `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:44`.
- Holders of the interface: `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`, set at `:56`), `RSSService.MarkdownService` (`server/router/rss/rss.go:45`, injected at `server/server.go:85`), and `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`); also passed as a parameter to `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`).

**h14** — computation site: `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`, which calls `markdownService.ExtractAll` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:356`) and assigns `memo.Payload.Tags` and `memo.Payload.Property` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:85-86`).
- Triggers: memo creation — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` (`CreateMemo`); memo content update — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447` (`UpdateMemo`, on the `content` field path); bulk rebuild — `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27`, currently uncalled).
- Extracted: `Tags` (list of `#tags`) and `Property` = `MemoPayload_Property{HasLink, HasTaskList, HasCode, HasIncompleteTasks, Title}` (`proto/gen/store/memo.pb.go:85-95`), where `Title` comes from a leading H1 (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:383-386`). Separately, the list/preview `Snippet` is computed on read via `getMemoContentSnippet` → `MarkdownService.GenerateSnippet` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:83`), applied at `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go:76-80`.

**h15** — enforcement sites:
- `APIV1Service.checkMemoReadAccess` (single-memo read) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:38`, visibility branch at `:55-65`
- `APIV1Service.ListMemos` visibility filter/`VisibilityList` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:219-227`
- `APIV1Service.ListMemoComments` filter — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:158-160`
- `APIV1Service.CreateMemoComment` (comment on private memo) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:41`
- `APIV1Service` memo-relation listing filter — `server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go:109-111`
- memo-converter relation/parent filter — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go:184-186`
- `APIV1Service` memo-attachment access check — `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:213-224`
- `FileServerService.checkAttachmentPermission` (attachment/file serving) — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:677` and `:699`
- `SSEClient.canReceive` (SSE broadcast filtering) — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:134-142`
- RSS feeds restricted to `store.Public` — `server/router/rss/rss.go:90` and `:141`
- sitemap restricted to `store.Public` — `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:150`
- notification/email eligibility — `server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go:309-312`

**r01** — Premise is wrong: there is no Redis anywhere in the codebase (no redis import in `go.mod`, no client code). The cache layer is a process-local in-memory cache: `store/cache/cache.go` (`Cache` struct at `:65`, `New` at `:74`, TTL sweeping goroutine, `Close` at `:187`). The store creates three of them — `instanceSettingCache`, `userCache`, `userSettingCache` — at `store/store.go:51-53` with `cache.Config{DefaultTTL: 10 * time.Minute, CleanupInterval: 5 * time.Minute, MaxItems: 1000}` (`store/store.go:39-44`). So user entries use a **10-minute** default TTL, in-memory, per-process; population/invalidations at `store/user.go:143,167,179`.

**r02** — Premise is wrong: there is no per-user API rate-limiting middleware, and none is registered. The only Echo middleware registered on the server is `middleware.Recover()` and `newCORSMiddleware(profile)` — `server/server.go:51-52`. A repo-wide search for rate-limiter usage (`golang.org/x/time/rate`, "ratelimit", "rate_limit") finds only a prose TODO-style comment in `internal/email/doc.go:86`. Request authorization is done by the Connect/gRPC interceptors (`server/router/api/v1/connect_interceptors.go`, `server/router/api/v1/authz.go`), which do auth/ACL, not rate limiting.

**r03** — Premise is wrong: there is no nightly database-cleanup job and no cron scheduler running in production. A generic cron scheduler package exists (`internal/scheduler/scheduler.go`, `internal/scheduler/parser.go`) but it has **zero callers outside its own package and tests** — nothing calls `scheduler.New` or `Register`. The only background work started by the server is the S3 presign runner on a 12-hour ticker (`server/server.go:153-174`, `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27`); user/memo cleanup happens synchronously inside the delete transaction (`store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:88`), not on a schedule.

**r04** — Premise is wrong: there is no message broker — neither NATS nor RabbitMQ (nor Kafka/AMQP) appears in `go.mod` or any Go source. Webhook delivery is in-process: a buffered Go channel `asyncPostQueue = make(chan *WebhookRequestPayload, 128)` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:39`) drained by 4 goroutines started in `init()` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:42-55`), each calling `Post` (`:120`). `PostAsync` (`:184`) enqueues non-blockingly and **drops** the event with a warning when the queue is full (`:191-195`); nothing is persisted, so pending deliveries are lost on restart.

**r05** — Premise is wrong: there is no GraphQL schema or GraphQL server anywhere (no `graphql` reference in any Go file or in `go.mod`). The public API is gRPC/Connect defined by Protocol Buffers under `proto/api/v1/` (generated Go in `proto/gen/api/v1/`), exposed over HTTP two ways: Connect handlers (`server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go`, `connect_services.go`) and a gRPC-Gateway REST/JSON transcoding layer registered by `APIV1Service.RegisterGateway` (`server/server.go:88`, `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:95`). Additional non-gRPC HTTP surfaces: the file server (`server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:124`), RSS (`server/router/rss/rss.go`), SSE (`server/router/api/v1/sse_handler.go`), and MCP (`server/server.go:92-96`).
